issue.title: Flaky: test_prompt_bar_xprompt_selector_requests VCS-tag tests fail only under full parallel suite
issue.description:
Discovered while verifying the sase-cu fix (unrelated flaky clipboard-modal test). Ran 'just test' three times in a row on an otherwise clean workspace to confirm the sase-cu fix held under xdist contention. On one of the three runs, these two tests failed:

  tests/ace/tui/test_prompt_bar_xprompt_selector_requests.py::test_vcs_tag_offers_project_local_xprompts_by_canonical_name
  tests/ace/tui/test_prompt_bar_xprompt_selector_requests.py::test_vcs_tag_directory_key_spelling_also_resolves

Both pass reliably in isolation (`pytest tests/ace/tui/test_prompt_bar_xprompt_selector_requests.py::<name> -q` — 2 passed) and passed on the other two full-suite runs. This is the same "passes alone, flakes under full-suite parallelism" shape as sase-cu, but in a completely different subsystem (xprompt VCS-tag selector requests, not artifact-file clipboard copying), so it is genuinely distinct root-cause work, not a re-occurrence of sase-cu's bug.

Not investigated further — out of scope for sase-cu. Worth investigating for xdist-order/shared-state issues (e.g., project/workspace registry state, xprompt directory-key resolution cache) that isn't reset between tests or workers.

evidence.note: Independent recurrence during unrelated publication_outbox module split verification on 2026-08-03: the full 26-worker just check run failed the same two VCS-tag selector tests, while both passed immediately in isolation. The run otherwise reached 25,812 passes and the changed backend modules do not touch xprompt or TUI state.

payload.close_reason: Backlog triage 2026-08-05: consolidating the full-parallel-suite / xdist flake class onto umbrella task sase-ct ('Flaky ACE TUI tests under full parallel just test run'). Every one of these reports the same shape — a single node fails under the full four-to-27-worker 'just test' or 'just check' run and passes immediately in isolation — so they share a root-cause class (xdist load sensitivity and shared-state leakage across workers) rather than per-test logic bugs. Per-test detail, including sase-cu's pump-free clipboard-task diagnosis, stays readable on each bead, and a +1 with fresh evidence reopens any of them if a specific node turns into a deterministic failure.

evidence.note: Independent recurrence on 2026-08-09 while landing reopened epic sase-hn.8.6: a full just check-full run on the hookspec annotation tree failed exactly tests/ace/tui/test_prompt_bar_xprompt_selector_requests.py::test_vcs_tag_offers_project_local_xprompts_by_canonical_name and ::test_vcs_tag_directory_key_spelling_also_resolves. Both passed immediately in a direct -vv rerun, and two subsequent full just check-full runs passed, including the final landed HEAD 11cd8634d. The changed file was tests/test_workspace_provider_hookspec.py, unrelated to xprompt selector/project registry state.
